subject: general
question: What is the maximum coverage provided under the "Cashless Treatment" scheme launched by Union Minister Nitin Gadkari for road accident victims?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹1.5 lakh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Union Minister Nitin Gadkari launched the "Cashless Treatment" scheme to cover road accident treatment costs up to ₹1.5 lakh for seven days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The "Cashless Treatment" scheme provides up to ₹1.5 lakh for accident victims' treatment if the police are informed within 24 hours.
 
• The scheme also offers ₹2 lakh ex-gratia payment for families of victims in hit-and-run cases.
 
• Road safety remains a top priority for the government with additional measures for safer transport of school children.
 
• The scheme aims to address the growing number of road accidents and reduce the financial burden on victims' families.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Ex-gratia Payment__

 __
 
• A payment made to the families of victims in exceptional cases such as hit-and-run accidents, to provide financial assistance in their time of need.
 
 
 
• Road Safety Measures__
 
 
• The government is implementing various measures, including helmet enforcement and safe transport systems for school children, to improve road safety across the country.
